Name: Animal Crossing Fruits
Author: Chesemtet
Description:
This mod change the orange,apple,cherry and peach to make them looks like fruits from Animal Crossing.

[u]Installation: 
[/u]Unzip the mod in your mods folder.
Make sure you have Content Patcher.
To uninstall ,remove the folder.

Downloads.Description: I had a weird glitch where all my items dissapear due to this mod. Sorry if this happened to you. This version should fix the problem.
